GRR.headline: Up to an inch of rain far southwest today; Small Craft Advisory on northern nearshore wate

areas.label: ~1 inch rain far SW
areas.quote:
Consensus from new 
model guidance and mean amounts show that far SW Van Buren could see 
an inch or so of rain today, with lesser amounts to the NE.

areas.label: Small Craft Advisory northern waters
areas.quote:
We will be issuing a Small Craft Advisory for the northern two 
marine zones for today and tonight.

areas.label: LIFR ceilings/visibility
areas.quote:
We continue to see the LIFR -VLIFR conditions in place for mainly
ceilings, but some visibilities also.

DTX.headline: Rain focused south of I-94 today; Small Craft Advisories on all nearshore waters

areas.label: Lingering rain south of I-94
areas.quote: Greatest chances from midday into the evening focused generally along/south of the I-94 corridor.

areas.label: Small Craft Advisory nearshore waters
areas.quote: While gales look unlikely, onshore flow warrants long duration Small Craft Advisories for all nearshore waters.

APX.headline: Morning fog, then frost risk Monday night in interior north MI

areas.label: Patchy fog, lingering drizzle
areas.quote: -Patchy fog and lingering drizzle continue this morning.

areas.label: Frost, interior and higher terrain
areas.quote: Coldest night be Monday night where interior areas/elevated terrain will likely observe lows near freezing, potentially leading to frost.

areas.label: Small Craft Advisory, NE winds
areas.quote: Post-frontal pressure gradient force winds will clear out low-level moisture and build breezy northeast winds today.

MQT.headline: Gusty NE winds bring beach hazards on Lake Superior; frost possible tonight

areas.label: Beach hazards, rip currents
areas.quote:
Gusty northeast winds will cause hazardous swimming conditions and 
rip current risks along Lake Superior today.

areas.label: NE gusts 20-30 kt, waves 4-6 ft
areas.quote:
High pressure building to the north today in addition to gusty winds 
mixing down in the wake of a Hudson Bay cold front looks to bring 20-
30 kt northeast gusts to most of Lake Superior.

areas.label: Light lake-enhanced showers
areas.quote:
Light lake-enhanced showers will be possible (~30%) especially 
along the terrain of the western and north-central UP this morning.

areas.label: Patchy frost inland overnight
areas.quote:
Clearing skies overnight will allow temperatures tonight 
to fall to the 30s away from the shores of the Great Lakes.
